notes.title: LONESTAR – English Localization Optimization Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Bounty Hunters!

A major update for the English localization is now live!

————————————————————————————————
[h3]​​Dev Notes:​​[/h3]

After we posted the call for English text improvements, lots of players signed up.
We chose Poimen, a native English speaker and experienced player, to help with the optimizations.

Over the past weeks, Poimen carefully improved texts for Units, Treasures, Talents, Keywords, and more.
LONESTAR has a huge amount of text. This took Poimen lots of time and effort.
A big thanks to Poimen for his hard work!

Many community players also gave great suggestions for the English text improvements.
Thank you all!

notes.title: Game Update & Optimization
notes.notes:
Greetings, Bounty Hunters!

[h3]Optimization & Adjustments:​​[/h3]

[olist]
[*] Clue Events will now appear during Vacation after the first two bosses in Difficulty 9.

[*] Translation corrections and optimizations.
[/olist]
————————————————————————————————
[h3]​​Dev Notes:​​[/h3]

Some players mentioned Clue Events were still too rare, so we've increased their appearance rate to give you more choices.

Last week, after posting about English text improvements, we received many applications. We've selected a native English-speaking veteran player to help optimize the text. You shall see the English text updates soon!

Thanks to all players! Your support is what helps LONESTAR keep getting better!

notes.title: Game Update | LONESTAR OST Now Available & Optimizations
notes.notes:
Hi Bounty Hunters!

It’s been a week since LONESTAR’s official launch, and we’ve got some exciting news!

The LONESTAR Original Soundtrack (OST) is now available! If you’ve been enjoying the music and want to support us (or just vibe out to the tunes), go check it out!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3636880/LONESTAR_Soundtrack/

Plus, the LONESTAR Steam Workshop is already filling up with awesome new content and helpful tools. If you’re looking to upgrade your experience or try out community creations, it’s a great time to dive in.

 Thinking about making your own mod? If you run into any issues, don’t hesitate to reach out,  we are happy to help! :)


[h3]𝙊𝙥𝙩𝙞𝙢𝙞𝙯𝙖𝙩𝙞𝙤𝙣 -[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Improved code structure to better support custom ship mods.
[*] Fixed a bug where parts with the Suppression buff, when quick-loaded, could cancel the effect of Infinite Energy Source Station after activation.
[*] Fixed an issue where the treasure Another Bounty Contract could accidentally remove the key event after a boss fight.
[*] Added 3840 x 1080 resolution option (currently in testing).
[*] Corrected some part level info in Difficulty 9 Bounty Contracts.
[*] Improved and clarified various in-game descriptions.
[/olist]

After nearly 4 years of development, LONESTAR has officially launched!

We hope you are having a blast exploring the galaxy and hunting bounties.

We are always keeping an eye on the community and listening to your feedback so we can keep improving the game.
And of course, if we come up with new and exciting ideas, we’ll keep adding them in!

Thanks for playing, and see you in the stars. 💫

notes.title: Update | Balancing Adjustments!
notes.notes:
[h3]Unit Balancing Adjustments -[/h3]

[b]Shielder:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Contract Core effect reworked: All loaded Energy Points are enhanced into 9-points. Tripower: add 1 [Blue] slot to self.
[*] Increasing Core effect reworked: If loaded Energy Point is the highest loaded point in this battle, gain Strength equal to the loaded point.
[*] Propulsion Core effect reworked: After movement, load 1 [White 5-point] Energy.
[*] Gathering Core slightly enhanced, now it has 2 White slots both before and after upgrading.
[*] Evolutionary Core slightly nerfed, now it has Orange, Blue, and White slots before upgrading, and Blue and two White slots after upgrading.
[/olist]
[b]Spacewalker:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Deca Battery renamed to Sixfold Battery, effect reworked: For every 6th Energy loaded, gain 14 extra Strength.
[*] Auto Diverter Weight reduced from 1 to 0.
[*] Central Replicator slightly nerfed, effect reworked: On load, load 2 Energy copies into the central Unit.
[/olist]
Based on player feedback, we have enhanced Units that were constantly sitting on the cold bench of both Shielder and Spacewalker, while slightly nerfing some OP ones. We hope that after these adjustments, every Unit will have the opportunity to shine.

The past two weeks have seen no updates, but we have been working intensively on the game! In addition to the third Spaceship, we are also designing brand-new bosses, with plans to add a new boss enemy at each stage. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Weekly Update | New Custom Mode!
notes.notes:
[h3]New Mode - Custom Mode[/h3]

Custom Mode is here!

In the Custom Mode, we provide various options of difficulty for you to choose from.

For instance:

(Hard) [One Hit Wonder] Starts with 1 Max HP and Treasure [Another Bounty Contract].
(Easy) [Talented] When selecting pilots, Reroll Chances can be used to choose any Random Talents as you like.

Additionally, you can highly customize your gameplay -
The number of enemies in each galaxy, appear order, enemies' HP, and even the energy generated per turn can all be adjusted.

Note: In the Custom Mode, achievements, difficulty unlocks, and statistics will be disabled.

*Custom Mode will be unlocked at Level 30.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588176/852ed1591d3f70483b1e62616ea873e012ab24c3.png[/img]

[h3]Optimization -[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Shop optimization: Besides the Shops for Attack/Support Units, all other shops will be offering at least 1 Attack Unit and 1 Support Unit. (Previous Seeds will be affected.)
[*] Treasure - Automatic Module is now exclusive for Spacewalker.
[/olist]
[h3]Bug Fixes -[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Treasure - Shattered Gem not appearing due to the Seed system.

notes.notes:
Howdy guys! LONESTAR is out now for a week and we are incredibly grateful for your support! It's been quite a wild and overwhelming ride for us since launch, and witnessing your enthusiasm for our game is truly unparalleled. A heartfelt thank you to each and every one of you! Today, we're thrilled to introduce the first content update for the game.

[h3]New Pilot - [/h3]
The Association is actively recruiting, and for every single week, a new pilot will be joining the team! Introducing this week's new star - Windrider!ːsteamhappyː

Windrider, as an SSR breed—Pandafolk within the Beastkin, is favored by almost all creatures. He is an ESTP type, which makes it effortless for him to make friends.
Inherent Talent - Make Friends: After the first two elite battles, get 1 chance to choose 1 from 2 Inherent Talents.

*Windrider will be unlocked at Level 64.

[olist]
[*] Added a brand-new pilot: Windrider.

[*] Adjusted the difficulty curve of different levels, allowing for a smoother progression.

[*] Slightly reduced stats of some enemies. Racehorse has been promoted to Elite, and Triangle is now a Henchman. Stats of these two enemies have been adjusted as well.

[*] Increased the number of revealed events during Vacation. Removed the Talent – Radar Detector. (We believe this would enhance players' strategic decision making during Vacations and mitigate the impact of randomness to some extent.)

[*] Changed the random upgrade option in the Event - Big Slot Machine to provide two choices: random upgrade to Attack Unit and random upgrade to Support Unit. (Also aims to reduce the impact of randomness to some extent.)

[*] Fixed an issue where players couldn't directly obtain the remaining common Treasures for free upon purchasing Monk's Prayer Beads in the shop.

[*] Increased the Power increase of DJ-HER7Z's Talent - Resonance to 3, and Resonance Amplifier now gains 4 Power.

[*] The probability of the Talent - Company Welfare is now publicly listed (15%).

[*] Added resolution support for 2880x1800 and 2560x1600.

[*] Optimized the visual effects performance of Destructor and Arc Amplifier.

[*] Fixed the issue of Build Master-Alice not benefiting from the Talent Detector.
[/olist]
[h3]Regarding our future plans for the game -[/h3]
[olist]
[*][b]Update schedule: [/b]Barring any unexpected hiccups (no nasty bugs demanding emergency fixes), we're sticking to a groovy Thursday update routine. This way, you know when to expect the latest scoop, and we get extra time to test things out, making the game version as steady as possible. For the time being you will see more updates of from us though, as many things still need to be adjusted and optimized in the game.

[*][b]What's fresh:[/b] Every week, we're dropping a new pilot, plus a smattering of other content updates (Events, Treasures, Enemies, you name it). The third ship? Yep, we're on it. We get that everyone's hoping to see new ships, but crafting one requires a serious amount of work. With just two of us on deck, we need some more time to ensure each ship is top-notch.

[*] [b]Content adjustments: [/b]We've got our eyes on your feedback and suggestions. Some of you have mentioned that the randomness is a bit too intense, or the difficulty curve needs fine-tuning, and we're easing into adjustments. Others want custom modes (handpicked random talents), challenge modes, etc. We think those ideas are swell, but some thoughtful design and rounds of testing are needed before these could be implemented into the game. Don't worry though, we've got your back, and all the good stuff will find its way in!
[/olist]
This game has been our labor of love for almost three years as a dynamic duo. Please rest assured that we will do our best to present the absolute best version of LONESTAR to all of you. Stay tuned!
